patches.name: x11-file-drop
patches.description: Validate complete X11 URI lists, prefer URI offers, and isolate stale selection replies per drag.

patches.name: explicit-f32-literals
patches.description: Make grid track float types explicit instead of relying on deprecated f32 literal fallback.

patches.name: hidden-window-creation
patches.description: Honor WindowOptions.show before mapping a newly created native window.

patches.name: x11-window-handle
patches.description: Expose the live Xcb window handle instead of panicking in HasWindowHandle.

patches.name: x11-application-lifetime
patches.description: Keep the X11 loop alive after its last window closes so the application owns zero-window lifetime and explicit Quit.

patches.name: macos-offscreen-display-link
patches.description: Stop the display link while an offscreen macOS window has no NSScreen and restart it when a screen is assigned.

patches.name: license
patches.description: Include the MIT license supplied with the reviewed binding notice.
